title: Prove each run repeats, and start from last cycle's plan

expected.says: Run's report for the demo export matches the expected report

blueprint.contract: Returns the sha256 hex digest of the plan's canonical JSON, status and starts only.
blueprint.idea: Two runs agree exactly when their plan digests do.

blueprint.signature: def harness(raw: dict, runs: int = 3, scenario: Scenario = Scenario("base")) -> Harness
blueprint.contract: Plans the same export, under a scenario ('base' by default), `runs` times from scratch, and returns a Harness of the plans' digests.
blueprint.idea: A determinism harness reruns from scratch and compares digests, not objective values.

blueprint.signature: def manifest(raw: dict, scenario: Scenario, plan: Plan) -> dict
blueprint.contract: Returns what a run depended on: the export's content hash as input, the scenario as a dictionary, the solver (name HIGHS, the OR-Tools version, the thread count), the plan's digest and its NPV rounded to cents.
blueprint.idea: A run is reproducible when its manifest pins the input, the settings and the solver.

lesson.title: 10.2.4 Versioned Input Snapshots, Pinned Solvers and Run Manifests

blueprint.signature: def check_golden(raw: dict, path: str | Path) -> list[str]
blueprint.contract: Returns every way today's plan of the export differs from the golden file: a changed input alone when the hashes differ (`input changed: golden <12 hex digits>, now <12 hex digits>`); otherwise, in this order, `status <golden> -> <now>` when the status differs, each project whose start differs as `<id>: start <golden> -> <now>` over the projects of both plans in id order (`None` for a project a plan does not fund), and `npv <golden> -> <now>` (whole $k, thousands commas) when the NPV moves by more than 0.5. Empty when they agree.
blueprint.idea: A golden test pins a reviewed plan of a fixed input, so a change that moves the plan fails until someone reviews it.

blueprint.signature: def write_golden(raw: dict, path: str | Path) -> None
blueprint.contract: Writes today's plan of the export as the golden file: one JSON object with the keys input (the export's content hash), npv, starts and status, sorted, indented by one space, with a final newline.
blueprint.idea: The golden plan is written by the code and reviewed by a person.

blueprint.signature: def hint_values(built: Built, previous: Plan) -> dict[tuple[str, int], float]
blueprint.contract: Returns a value for every variable of the model: 1.0 where the previous plan starts that project in that year, else 0.0. A previous start the model has no variable for is dropped.
blueprint.idea: A MIP start must name only variables the new model has.

lesson.title: 11.2.1 MIP Starts From Last Cycle's Plan

blueprint.signature: def solve(request: Request, previous: Plan | None = None) -> Plan
blueprint.contract: Plans a request; with a previous plan, hands HiGHS the hint as a starting solution.
blueprint.idea: A warm start changes where the search begins, never the optimal plan.

lesson.title: 11.2.1 MIP Starts From Last Cycle's Plan

blueprint.signature: def warm_solve(raw: dict, previous: Plan) -> Plan
blueprint.contract: Plans the export starting from last cycle's plan.
blueprint.idea: Next cycle starts from this cycle's plan.
